# SortReceipts

> SortReceipts is a browser-based receipt scanner and expense tracker for small businesses. Photograph a printed receipt; the app reads the vendor, amount, date and tax, files it under one of 11 business categories, and keeps monthly income, expense and profit reports current. Nothing to install — it runs in a browser.

Full content for retrieval: /llms-full.txt. Long-form guide: /guide. Questions and answers: /faq. Company and product facts: /about.

## Problems it solves

- **Month-end catch-up**: receipts sit in a drawer until the last day. SortReceipts records each one when it happens, so the month closes without a backlog.
- **Retyping totals**: vendor, amount, date and tax are read from the photo instead of typed by hand.
- **Not knowing where the money went**: every expense carries one of 11 categories, and the category split plus profit trend are on one screen.
- **Reformatting before handing books to an accountant**: monthly reports export as CSV, which Excel, Numbers and Google Sheets open directly.

## Who it is for

Small business owners who deal with paper receipts: restaurants, cafés, food trucks, retail shops and freelancers. One project represents one store or one line of business, and projects keep separate books.

## How it works

1. Create a project (one store or one line of business).
2. Photograph the receipt and check the four extracted fields: vendor, amount, date, tax.
3. Read the monthly report: income, expenses, category split, profit trend. Export to CSV at month end.
4. Optionally run the AI business review, which reads the month's records and writes a short summary of where the money went.

## What it does

- Reads printed receipts from photos in JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC or HEIF, up to 10 MB each.
- Extracts vendor, total amount, invoice date and tax amount from the recognised text.
- Categorizes each expense automatically: Meals & Entertainment, Travel & Lodging, Transportation & Fuel, Office Supplies, Software & Subscriptions, Rent & Facilities, Utilities, Marketing & Advertising, Professional Services, Equipment & Hardware, Other.
- Builds monthly reports: income, expenses, category split, profit trend.
- Answers plain-language questions such as "how much did I spend on meals last month?" using the user's own records.
- Exports reports as CSV on paid plans.
- The product interface is available in English and Chinese. The marketing site also has pages in Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Japanese and Korean.

## Pricing (USD, monthly)

- Free: 5 receipts a month, 1 project, basic reports, no export.
- Pro: $3.99 — 200 receipts a month, 10 projects, CSV export, AI business review.
- Business: $13.99 — unlimited receipts and projects, priority support.

## Limitations

- Printed receipts work best. Handwritten notes and poorly lit photos may need manual correction.
- Amounts are stored as entered; the app is not a tax filing service and does not compute VAT returns.
- The product interface is available in English and Chinese only. Other languages cover the marketing page, not the product itself.

- Data is stored on Cloudflare infrastructure and encrypted in transit; records can be deleted from the account, and the whole account can be deleted by email request.
